title: Recover a bounded storage incident
goal: Combine target validation, copy recovery, mount diagnosis and actual access verification.
challenge: Diagnose and recover the bounded copy incident. Record target evidence, checker status, mount-option and permission failures, independent content/metadata comparison and actual learner access. Preserve the original and clean up only exact practice resources.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-storage-8; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test "$(readlink -e /home/learner)" = /home/learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(df -Pk /home/learner | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 1638400 && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 mnt
steps.explanation: Create a new private practice area. Stop on collision; never reuse an unknown directory.
steps.expected: At least 1600 MiB initially free; keep 1 GiB free throughout.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(id -un)" = learner && test "$w" = /home/learner/ll-storage-8 && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(readlink -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a .)" = learner:700 && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 1048576 || return 19; local f b limit; for f in ./* ./.[!.]* ./..?*; do test -e "$f" || test -L "$f" || continue; b=${f#./}; case "$b" in mnt) test -d "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || return 19; continue;; disk.img|repair.img) limit=134217728;; command-output.tmp) limit=1048577;; partition.log|layout.log|mkfs.log|identity.log|expected.txt|expected.sha256|original.sha256|uuid.log|defect.log|check.log|repair.log|recheck.log|practice.fstab|live-fstab.sha256|mount.log|evidence.txt) limit=1048576;; *) return 19;; esac; test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" && test "$(stat -c %h:%u "$f")" = "1:$(id -u)" && test "$(stat -c %s "$f")" -le "$limit" || return 19; done; }; file_ok() { guard && case "$1" in disk.img|repair.img) test "$(stat -c %s "$1")" = 134217728;; *) return 19;; esac; }; run() { guard && test ! -e command-output.tmp && test ! -L command-output.tmp || return 19; (set -o noclobber; : > command-output.tmp) || return 19; local rc bytes; (set -o pipefail; sudo timeout -k 2s 30s bash -c 'ulimit -f 262144; exec "$@"' bash "$@" 2>&1 | head -c 1048577 > command-output.tmp); rc=$?; test ! -L command-output.tmp && test "$(stat -c %h command-output.tmp)" = 1 || return 19; bytes=$(stat -c %s command-output.tmp); head -c 1048576 command-output.tmp; rm -- command-output.tmp || return 19; test "$bytes" -le 1048576 || return 20; return "$rc"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define file, space and bounded-operation guards. Guest root can override these accident-prevention checks.
steps.expected: Exact private workspace and allowed members only: two 128 MiB images;16 logs/notes <=1 MiB;30s plus2s worker grace;256 MiB regular-file limit;1 MiB captured output.

steps.command: maps() { guard || return 19; case "$1" in disk.img|repair.img) sudo timeout -k 2s 15s losetup -n -O NAME -j "$w/$1";; *) return 19;; esac; }; nomap() { local v; v=$(maps "$1") || return 19; test -z "$v"; }; dev_ok() { file_ok "$2" && [[ "$1" =~ ^/dev/loop[0-9]+p1$ ]] || return 19; local l=${1%p1} v; v=$(maps "$2") || return 19; test "$v" = "$l" && test -b "$1" && test "$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s losetup -n -O BACK-FILE "$l")" = "$w/$2" || return 19; v=$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s losetup --raw -n -O BACK-INO,OFFSET,SIZELIMIT "$l") || return 19; test "$v" = "$(stat -c %i "$2") 0 0" && test "$(timeout -k 2s 15s lsblk -nro PKNAME "$1")" = "${l#/dev/}" && test "$(cat /sys/class/block/${1#/dev/}/partition)" = 1 && test "$(cat /sys/class/block/${1#/dev/}/start)" = 2048 && test "$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s blockdev --getsize64 "$1")" = 125829120; }; mounted() { local mounts number; mounts=$(timeout -k 2s 15s findmnt -rn -o MAJ:MIN) || return 19; number=$(timeout -k 2s 15s lsblk -dnro MAJ:MIN "$1") || return 19; [[ "$number" =~ ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ ]] || return 19; grep -Fx "$number" <<< "$mounts" >/dev/null; }; off() { dev_ok "$1" "$2" || return 19; mounted "$1"; local rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1; }; target_ok() { guard && test -d mnt && test ! -L mnt && test "$(readlink -e mnt)" = "$w/mnt" || return 19; local targets contents; targets=$(timeout -k 2s 15s findmnt -rn -o TARGET) || return 19; if grep -Fx "$w/mnt" <<< "$targets" >/dev/null || grep -F "$w/mnt/" <<< "$targets" >/dev/null; then return 19; fi; contents=$(timeout -k 2s 15s find mnt -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit) || return 19; test -z "$contents"; }; on() { dev_ok "$1" "$2" || return 19; local rows number; rows=$(timeout -k 2s 15s findmnt -rn -o MAJ:MIN,TARGET,FSROOT) || return 19; number=$(timeout -k 2s 15s lsblk -dnro MAJ:MIN "$1") || return 19; [[ "$number" =~ ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ ]] || return 19; test "$(grep -E "^$number " <<< "$rows")" = "$number $w/mnt /" && ! grep -F " $w/mnt/" <<< "$rows" >/dev/null; }; note_ok() { on "$1" "$2" && test -f mnt/note && test ! -L mnt/note && test "$(stat -c %h mnt/note)" = 1; }; true
steps.explanation: Bind each operation to a single backing-file mapping, zero offset, exact partition and exact mountpoint. Query errors refuse approval.
steps.expected: Wrong or duplicate mappings, substituted paths, occupied/nonempty mountpoints and mounted offline targets are refused.

steps.command: guard && test ! -e disk.img && test ! -L disk.img && (set -o noclobber; : > disk.img) && timeout -k 2s 15s truncate -s 128M disk.img && file_ok disk.img && printf "label: gpt\nstart=2048, size=245760, type=L\n" | run sfdisk disk.img > partition.log 2>&1 && run sfdisk --dump disk.img > layout.log 2>&1 && head -n 12 layout.log

attach() { file_ok "$1" && nomap "$1" || return 19; local l; l=$(run losetup --find --show --partscan "$w/$1") || return; [[ "$l" =~ ^/dev/loop[0-9]+$ ]] || return 19; for n in $(seq 1 50); do test -b "${l}p1" && break; sleep 0.1; done; dev_ok "${l}p1" "$1" && printf "%s\n" "${l}p1"; }; part=$(attach disk.img) && off "$part" disk.img && lsblk -o NAME,TYPE,SIZE,MOUNTPOINTS "${part%p1}"

off "$part" disk.img && signature=$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s blkid -p -s TYPE -s PTTYPE -s USAGE -o value "$part"); rc=$?; { test "$rc" = 0 || test "$rc" = 2; } && test -z "$signature" && off "$part" disk.img && run mke2fs -t ext4 -L LL_STORAGE "$part" > mkfs.log 2>&1 && run blkid -p "$part" > identity.log 2>&1 && head -n 4 identity.log

off "$part" disk.img && target_ok && run mount -o nodev,nosuid,noexec "$part" "$w/mnt" && on "$part" disk.img && on "$part" disk.img && test ! -e mnt/note && test ! -L mnt/note && run chown learner:learner "$w/mnt" && run chmod 0700 "$w/mnt" && printf "Storage practice: known content.\n" > mnt/note && chmod 0600 mnt/note && printf "Storage practice: known content.\n" > expected.txt && sha256sum mnt/note > expected.sha256 && cmp expected.txt mnt/note && stat -c "%U:%G %a" mnt/note
steps.explanation: Capture independent content and access expectations.

steps.command: on "$part" disk.img && run umount "$w/mnt" && off "$part" disk.img

off "$part" disk.img && run losetup -d "${part%p1}" && nomap disk.img && test ! -e repair.img && test ! -L repair.img && (set -o noclobber; : > repair.img) && timeout -k 2s 30s cp --reflink=never -- disk.img repair.img && file_ok repair.img && sha256sum disk.img > original.sha256 && cmp disk.img repair.img && part=$(attach disk.img) && copy=$(attach repair.img) && off "$part" disk.img && off "$copy" repair.img

unique_uuid() { local u; dev_ok "$1" "$2" || return 19; u=$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$1") || return 19; test -n "$u" || return 19; local hits; hits=$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s blkid -c /dev/null -t UUID="$u" -o device) || return 19; test "$(printf "%s\n" "$hits" | wc -l)" = 1 && test "$hits" = "$1"; }; uuid=$(sudo timeout -k 2s 15s blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$part") && test -n "$uuid" && { unique_uuid "$part" disk.img; first_rc=$?; unique_uuid "$copy" repair.img; copy_rc=$?; test "$first_rc" = 1 && test "$copy_rc" = 1; } && printf "Duplicate UUID: refuse UUID mount; use a verified exact device.\n" && off "$copy" repair.img && run tune2fs -U random "$copy" > uuid.log 2>&1 && unique_uuid "$copy" repair.img && unique_uuid "$part" disk.img
steps.explanation: Reject duplicate identity; disambiguate only the copy.

steps.command: off "$copy" repair.img && run debugfs -w -R "set_inode_field /note links_count 2" "$copy" > defect.log 2>&1 && off "$copy" repair.img && run e2fsck -fn "$copy" > check.log 2>&1; rc=$?; head -n 16 check.log; test "$rc" = 4
steps.explanation: Create the displayed copy-only metadata incident.

steps.command: off "$copy" repair.img && { run e2fsck -fy "$copy" > repair.log 2>&1; rc=$?; test "$rc" = 1 && off "$copy" repair.img && run e2fsck -fn "$copy" > recheck.log 2>&1 && head -n 12 repair.log; }
steps.explanation: Repair from evidence, not by recreating/formatting data.

steps.command: off "$copy" repair.img && target_ok && run mount -o ro,nodev,nosuid,noexec "$copy" "$w/mnt" && on "$copy" repair.img && ! sh -c 'printf changed > mnt/note' && note_ok "$copy" repair.img && cmp expected.txt mnt/note && on "$copy" repair.img && run mount -o remount,rw,nodev,nosuid,noexec "$copy" "$w/mnt" && on "$copy" repair.img && note_ok "$copy" repair.img && run chmod 0000 mnt/note && ! cat mnt/note && note_ok "$copy" repair.img && run chmod 0600 mnt/note && note_ok "$copy" repair.img && cmp expected.txt mnt/note && sha256sum -c expected.sha256 && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a mnt/note)" = learner:learner:600 && cat mnt/note && on "$copy" repair.img && run umount "$w/mnt" && off "$copy" repair.img && sha256sum -c original.sha256
steps.explanation: Distinguish ro mount and permission fault, then verify data and intended identity.
steps.expected: Actual failed writes/reads, narrow repairs, expected recovered bytes and unchanged original.

steps.command: clean_loop() { file_ok "$2" || return 19; nomap "$2"; local rc=$?; if test "$rc" = 0; then return 0; fi; test "$rc" = 1 && off "$1" "$2" && run losetup -d "${1%p1}" && nomap "$2"; }; guard && target_ok && clean_loop "$part" disk.img && { test ! -e repair.img || clean_loop "${copy:-}" repair.img; }

hints: Do not reformat to hide the defect: that destroys recovery evidence.
A successful mount is not proof of correct contents or user access.
Keep the original and compare expected bytes before cleanup.
review: Retain the listed observations and explain any failed checks. Completion is your self-review, not automatically verified assessment.
Combine target validation, copy recovery, mount diagnosis and actual access verification.
Confirm exact cleanup and no unrelated target changes.
